en.headline: Cats plays its last added week at Xiqu Centre through Sunday
en.dek: West Kowloon’s Grand Theatre hosts final extra performances of the Andrew Lloyd Webber musical from Tuesday to 13 September, after the Hong Kong run was extended twice.
body: Andrew Lloyd Webber’s Cats returns to the Grand Theatre at the Xiqu Centre on Tuesday for a last block of added performances, running through Sunday 13 September, the West Kowloon Cultural District said.

The production opened in Hong Kong on 6 August and was extended twice. The latest dates, labelled as final additional performances, are scheduled at 7.30pm from Tuesday to Sunday, with 2.30pm matinees on Saturday and Sunday. There is no performance tonight, a Monday.

West Kowloon lists the running time as about two hours and 40 minutes, including a 20-minute interval. The show is performed in English with Chinese surtitles. Tickets remain on sale through Cityline, with non-peak prices from HK$388 and peak-day prices from HK$488. Children under five are not admitted, and the staging includes laser, pyrotechnic and strobe effects.

The Hong Kong engagement is presented by a group of organisers including Season Entertainment and GWB Entertainment. The venue is the Grand Theatre at the Xiqu Centre in the West Kowloon Cultural District.

zh.headline: 音樂劇《貓》戲曲中心終極加場 演至周日
zh.dek: 西九文化區戲曲中心大劇院由周二起至9月13日加開《貓》最後一輪場次，香港站已兩度延長，周一休演。
body: 安德魯・勞伊德韋伯音樂劇《貓》將於周二重返西九文化區戲曲中心大劇院，展開標明為「終極加場」的最後一輪演出，演至9月13日星期日。
製作8月6日在港開演後已兩度加場。西九公布的最後加場為周二至周日晚上7時30分，周六及周日另設下午2時30分場。今日周一沒有演出。
西九資料指演出長約2小時40分，包括20分鐘中場休息，以英語演出並配中文字幕。門票仍經Cityline發售，非繁忙時段票價由388港元起，繁忙時段由488港元起。五歲以下小童恕不招待，舞台含激光、煙火及頻閃燈效果。
香港站由禽季娛樂及GWB娛樂等機構主辦，場地為西九文化區戲曲中心大劇院。
